title: Copula Active Subspaces II: Error Decomposition, A Posteriori Estimation, and Sharpness of the Bounds
summary: The Copula Active Subspaces (CAS) method of Part I estimates a non-Gaussian observation-noise density $π_{\boldsymbol{n}}$ from residual samples. Its KL divergence $\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{KL}}(π_{\boldsymbol{n}}\,\|\,\widehatπ_{\boldsymbol{n}})$ admits an exact decomposition into marginal, projection and reduced-density terms and bounds the posterior KL divergence averaged over the true predictive distribution.
